mapper.insert: insert into orders(order_no, user_id, total_amount, status, pay_type, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, remark, create_time, update_time) values (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{payType}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverAddress}, #{remark}, now(), now())
mapper.select: select id,order_no,user_id,total_amount,status,pay_type, receiver_name,receiver_phone,receiver_address,remark, create_time,pay_time,ship_time,finish_time,cancel_time,update_time from orders where user_id = #{userId} order by create_time desc

select id,order_no,user_id,total_amount,status,pay_type, receiver_name,receiver_phone,receiver_address,remark, create_time,pay_time,ship_time,finish_time,cancel_time,update_time from orders order by create_time desc
mapper.update: update orders set status = 5, cancel_time = now(), update_time = now() where order_no = #{orderNo} and user_id = #{userId} and status = 0
update orders set status = 5, cancel_time = now(), update_time = now() where order_no = #{orderNo} and status = 0
update orders set status = 1, pay_time = now(), update_time = now() where order_no = #{orderNo} and status = 0
update orders set status = 2, ship_time = now(), update_time = now() where order_no = #{orderNo} and status = 1
update orders set status = 3, finish_time = now(), update_time = now() where order_no = #{orderNo} and user_id = #{userId} and status = 2
update orders set status = 5, cancel_time = now(), update_time = now() where order_no = #{orderNo} and user_id = #{userId} and status in (1,2,3)
